title: toxicodendron radicans subsp. divaricatum
intro: Toxicodendron radicans subsp. divaricatum, commonly known as Eastern Poison Ivy, is a subspecies of the Poison Ivy plant, native to Eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Eastern Poison Ivy include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its use in treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
